bead.title: claude-tui: implement AccountHarness.Identity and QuotaHarness.Quota off live CLI session via anthropic/ helpers
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 requires that subscription billing signals (identity, quota/usage) for claude-tui be observed off the live CLI session rather than API-metered numbers, parsed through the neutral internal/harnesses/anthropic/ helpers introduced by child #1.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claudetui/account.go: AccountHarness.Identity is unimplemented or returns a placeholder.
- internal/harnesses/claudetui/quota.go: QuotaHarness.Quota is unimplemented or returns a placeholder.
- internal/harnesses/anthropic/: parsing helpers for CLI auth-status and quota-observation output exist but have no claude-tui caller.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Implement AccountHarness.Identity to invoke the CLI auth-status surface within the PTY session and parse the result via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers.
2. Implement QuotaHarness.Quota to read the CLI quota-observation surface within the same session and parse via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers.
3. Surface errors verbatim; do not fall back to static or cassette-derived values.

NON-SCOPE:
- PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- Session pool, /clear, orphan reaping (sibling child B).
- Performance benchmarking and 2x/10ms ratchets (sibling child D).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.

Depends on child #1 and sibling child A (needs a working PTY session). Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3, CONTRACT-004.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiAccountIdentity asserts AccountHarness.Identity() returns the CLI-observed account string parsed via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers.
2) TestClaudeTuiQuotaObservation asserts QuotaHarness.Quota() returns CLI-observed usage parsed via internal/harnesses/anthropic helpers.
3) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
4) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
